title: Pure B1.11 micro Campbell leaf response
equation: For swTypeTred=1: xTpot if xp+DPL<0; else xTpot/(1+((xp+DPL)*PLhalf)**CampA) for SWO2ECT<3 or xTpot/(1+((xp+DPL)*(PLhalf/alptotal))**CampA) for SWO2ECT=3.
scope: micro solver type-1 Campbell response only
explicit xp, DPL, xTpot, PLhalf, CampA, SWO2ECT and ALPTOTAL inputs
negative-potential bypass, both denominator branches and deterministic source oracle
non_goals: swTypeTred=2, de Willigen/Jong-van-Lier full uptake equations, or solver iteration
M/K lookup-table lifecycle, saved work arrays, initialization/restart or parallel ownership
root-stress composition, MICRO salinity/frost admission, or root-sink mass booking
pass_conditions: 100000 deterministic source-domain vectors bitwise match both exact source branches
negative xp+DPL, SWO2ECT branch split, A/B/A stateless replay and fail-closed inputs pass
full MICRO model remains explicitly unadmitted
